goal: Implement GPU-validated optimizations from discovery to achieve 10x speedup on simulate!(). All work on branch speed/fused-projection. All speedup claims backed by Metal GPU benchmarks.
v1_lesson: v1 build stories were based on CPU-only benchmarks. All 4 stories were marked 'done' with CPU speedup numbers but produced ZERO speedup on Metal GPU. v2 stories are created by the discovery loop ONLY after GPU validation.

gpu_baseline.note: Baseline is FUSED path (default). Fused is 3.65x slower on GPU. Signal chain is 6ms (not 487ms — SPEED-000 was wrong).

speedup_summary.after_v2_002: ~1,610 ms (tiled K=16, 11.9× from default, 3.4× from unfused)

stories.title: Disable fused path as default — immediate 3.5× speedup
stories.gpu_benchmark_details: Fused: 19.16s, Unfused: 5.43s on Metal M3 Max. Gammex 472 128^3, 256×32×360 sinogram, 234 energy bins.
stories.description: The v1 fused kernel (siddon_fused_poly_project!) is 3.5× slower than the unfused sequential path on Metal GPU because 234 energy accumulators (936 bytes) cause massive register spilling. Change the default from fused=true to fused=false in _forward_project_poly!. Keep fused code for tiled approach.
requirements: Change default fused parameter to false in _forward_project_poly! signature
Or better: detect n_energies > threshold (e.g., 32) and auto-select unfused
Keep fused kernel code intact for future tiled fusion work
Verify simulate!() output is identical (fused and unfused produce same results)
acceptanceCriteria: simulate!() runs in <6.5s on Gammex 472 128^3 benchmark (was 19.2s with fused)
Output sinogram matches reference within Float32 tolerance
No API changes — workspace creation and simulate! calls remain the same

stories.title: Tiled energy fusion K=16 — 3.66× speedup on forward projection
stories.gpu_benchmark_details: K=16: 95.3ms/tile × 15 tiles = 1430ms vs unfused 5232ms on Metal M3 Max. Confirmed across bench_speed_001.jl and bench_speed_003.jl. Per-bin marginal: 5.96ms.
stories.description: Replace 234 sequential Siddon calls (each 22.85ms) with 15 tiled fused kernel calls (each 95.3ms at K=16). Each tile traces DDA through mask ONCE and accumulates 16 energy bins via μ_table lookup. Tiles add partial Beer-Lambert sums to I_transmitted buffer. Final -log applied after all tiles. Re-uses 95% of existing siddon_fused_poly_project! kernel.
requirements: Create siddon_tiled_poly_project! function that takes tile_start::Int32 and Val(K)
Modify kernel to offset μ_table reads: μ_tbl[mat, tile_start + e - 1]
Modify kernel to offset bowtie reads: bt[bt_base + (tile_start+e-2)*ncnr]
Kernel ADDS partial Beer-Lambert sum to I_buffer (not -log to sinogram)
Pad μ_table and wη to 240 = 15×16 (zero-pad last 6 bins) for even tiling
Only compile Val(16) — last tile uses zero-padded weights, no extra specialization
Update _forward_project_poly! to use tiled loop instead of sequential energy loop
Keep unfused path available as fallback (fused=false kwarg)
acceptanceCriteria: Forward projection completes in <1.8s on Gammex 472 128^3 benchmark (3.0× minimum speedup, target 3.66×)
Full simulate!() completes in <2.0s (was ~19.2s fused default)
Output sinogram matches unfused reference within Float32 tolerance (max abs diff < 1e-5)
No API changes — workspace creation and simulate! calls remain the same
Bowtie spectral transmission handled correctly per-tile
stories.depends_on: SPEED-BUILD-V2-001 (disable fused first, then replace with tiled)

invalidated_optimizations.reason: Per-bin cost is instruction-bound, not data-dependent. All-zero μ_table = same timing as real. Air has non-zero μ (0.14 mm⁻¹). GPU executes all K FMAs regardless of data values.
Table is 16KB, fits entirely in L1 cache. Zero vs real μ_table gives identical timing. Layout is irrelevant.
Signal chain is only 6ms total (0.1% of simulate!()). Fusion saves 5ms. Not worth implementation effort.
Saves 2.5ms. Already included implicitly in tiled approach (outputs I_transmitted, not -log).
